description: This bar chart, titled “Per-specialty terms,” illustrates the negative log probability of various medical terms within six clinical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—after fine-tuning a language model on each specialty. The horizontal axis lists the specialties, while the vertical axis represents “Negative log probability,” scaled linearly from -22 to -27. Each specialty has a group of six bars, one for each of the six specialties, colored according to a legend: light beige for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. The bars are arranged in descending order of negative log probability, with the light blue bar (representing the “Fine-tuned on:” category) appearing as the shortest bar in each group, indicating the lowest negative log probability. Within each group, the bars for the specialty being evaluated (e.g., the “Cardio” group has a light blue bar for Cardio) are consistently the tallest, indicating the highest negative log probability, while the bars for other specialties are shorter, indicating lower negative log probability. The chart visually demonstrates that terms from a given specialty are assigned higher negative log probabilities when the model is fine-tuned on that specialty, suggesting a stronger association or relevance.
